answer.answer: Advanced Straylight from evaluation into implementation and committed child checkpoint checkpoint:5d8eb98d-d360-6f31-3602-0d3fcf5ae135.

claims.value: Straylight is a user-owned, portable, agent-first context and durable-work layer preserving learned knowledge and live work state so later agents can inspect, revise, advance, and hand off complex work.

The earlier benchmark measured one-shot BM25 at about 1,070 mean estimated tokens versus about 2,932 for the prototype workspace. This is a regression baseline—not support for the BM25 shell as the target architecture. Persistent-API reporting must separate cumulative cached replay from uncached input.

The first persistent build slice is a snapshot-pinned workspace supporting parent-checkpoint reopen, N-to-N+1 refresh with an exposed diff, combined exact and lexical retrieval with a pluggable semantic path, typed batched query/read operations, and immutable child commits preserving parent and source lineage.

The slice passes only when every transition case completes within four workspace calls, matches direct-filesystem answer claims, reports cached replay and uncached input separately, returns the known N-to-N+1 delta without reconstructing the complete prior corpus when unnecessary, and commits an immutable child naming its parent and exact sources.

checkpoint.objective: Implement and validate the first persistent, snapshot-pinned Straylight workspace slice that resumes revision N, refreshes to N+1, exposes its delta, retrieves evidence through a typed API, and commits an immutable lineage-preserving child.
current_state: Project-owner authority advances Straylight from evaluation into implementation.
Retrieval-only results remain a regression lane.
Cached replay and uncached input are separate measurements.
The first production-shaped target is a persistent snapshot-pinned workspace.
decisions: Retain the BM25 shell only as a regression fixture.
Build typed batched resume/refresh, query, read, and checkpoint operations.
Combine exact and lexical retrieval behind an interface supporting a pluggable semantic retriever.
Require immutable child checkpoints with parent and exact-source lineage.
open_questions: Which semantic retriever should implement the first plugin?
Which storage engine should back the workspace after API and harness validation?
next_actions: Implement persistent workspace identity and revision pinning.
Add a known N-to-N+1 transition fixture and bounded-delta test.
Test combined retrieval and semantic replaceability.
Run the four-call transition harness and separate token accounting.
